claims.meaning: MessagePort owns a task source. Its enabled message queue participates in the event loop, so this schedules a later task rather than chaining only promise microtasks.
Posting to an entangled port adds a task to the receiving port message queue.
Setting onmessage enables the receiving queue.
Closing a port detaches and disentangles it. The standard encourages explicit closing to allow resource collection.

implementationBoundary: A private channel can yield without reading or writing network resources. Constructor or delivery setup failure still needs a supported fallback. The standard does not promise timing, foreground status, or a universal immunity to browser throttling. Native browser execution provides the separate timing evidence.
fixtureBoundary: Normal native MessageChannel is used directly. Separate fictional scenarios deliberately remove it or make construction throw to exercise the actual timer fallback. No operating-system focus or unrelated browser window is changed.
